name: TIP4P-Ew water
source: the paper's Table I and its supporting information (EPAPS E-JCPSA6-120-512415: the parameter table)
references: H. W. Horn, W. C. Swope, J. W. Pitera, J. D. Madura, T. J. Dick, G. L. Hura, T. Head-Gordon, J. Chem. Phys. 120, 9665 (2004)

atom_types.name: MW
atom_types.description: TIP4P-Ew M site (massless, 0.125 A from O on the bisector)

pairs.name: OW
pairs.comment: O-O Lennard-Jones: q 1.04844 e (M; each H half of it), d_OM 0.12500 A, epsilon 0.162750 kcal/mol, sigma 3.16435 A, r_OH 0.9572 A, H-O-H 104.52 deg

bonds.name: OW-HW
bonds.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (MacKerell et al. 1998, SI: OT-HT 450.00, HT-OT-HT 55.00) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

angles.name: HW-OW-HW
angles.comment: CHARMM's TIP3P constants (MacKerell et al. 1998, SI: OT-HT 450.00, HT-OT-HT 55.00) at the model's geometry; the model is rigid, they serve a flexible run only

notes: built by CAPS (bench/ff/make_water_models.py) from the paper's Table I and its supporting information (EPAPS E-JCPSA6-120-512415: the parameter table)
rigid model: run it with its bonds and angle constrained (SHAKE / RATTLE in LAMMPS, SETTLE in GROMACS)
